evidence.text: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 曷 represents the sound.
Phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声, OC *kʰaːd, *ɡrad): semantic 氵 (“water”) + phonetic 曷 (OC *ɡaːd); dry, exhausted (of water).
